name: acquire_aish_coordinator_lease
purpose: Makes the caller the single coordinator of an AISH execution session for 10 minutes and returns the leaseNonce and fencingToken that plan, approve, dispatch, pause, resume and retry calls require.
useWhen: Before put_aish_execution_plan, approve_aish_execution_plan, dispatch_aish_execution_plan, pause_aish_execution_session, resume_aish_execution_session or retry_aish_execution_plan
Your lease is about to expire (renew: same coordinatorId, new idempotencyKey)
You got 'fencing token is stale', 'lease is not active' or lost your leaseNonce
avoidWhen: Another coordinator (often a person in the web cockpit) holds an unexpired lease: do not try to take over; ask the user
You only need to read the session: use get_aish_execution_session

inputs.notes: Session id.
Max 200 chars, unique to this agent run, e.g. 'agent-codex-<random>'. Keep it for the whole session; never reuse another coordinator's id.
8 to 240 chars. Same key while the lease is active returns the same lease unchanged; a new key renews it.

preconditions: Caller can manage the session's workspace
No other coordinatorId holds an unexpired lease on this session
returns: sessionId, coordinatorId, leaseNonce (keep private; needed for every fenced call; never shown again), fencingToken (integer), status 'active', leasedAt, expiresAt (leasedAt + 10 min).

errors.when: AISH execution session already has an active coordinator.
errors.fix: Read get_aish_execution_session -> coordinatorLease. Tell the user who coordinates and when the lease expires; retry only after expiresAt and with the user's consent.

errors.when: Coordinator id and idempotency key are required.
errors.fix: Send coordinatorId and a key of 8+ chars.

errors.when: AISH execution session not found. / You do not have permission to access this AISH execution session.
errors.fix: Check sessionId; caller must be a workspace manager.

gotchas.text: Calling again with the same key does NOT extend the lease.
Renewing (same coordinatorId + new key) issues a NEW leaseNonce and fencingToken + 1: always use the latest pair, the old one becomes stale.
If you lose the nonce, re-acquire with the same coordinatorId and a new key.
When a lease expires and someone else acquires it, your token is dead.
Do not write the leaseNonce into comments or event payloads.

name: append_aish_execution_session_command
purpose: Appends an ordered, idempotent event to an AISH execution session and optionally moves its status (for example draft -> ready -> awaiting-approval, back to draft, or canceled).
useWhen: Moving a session with a plan from draft to ready, then from ready to awaiting-approval so a manager can approve the plan hash
Recording a structured note such as a clarification answer on the session timeline
Canceling a session for good, after the user asked for it
Returning a session to draft to change its plan
avoidWhen: Approving the plan: use approve_aish_execution_plan (status approved is rejected here)
Starting or continuing execution: use dispatch_aish_execution_plan or resume_aish_execution_session (status executing is rejected here)
Pausing: use pause_aish_execution_session
Asking a human to decide on a conflict or checkpoint: use request_aish_execution_checkpoint
Publishing a plan: use put_aish_execution_plan

inputs.notes: Session id.
8 to 240 chars, unique per command in this session. Reuse only to retry the identical command.
Event type, max 120 chars, e.g. 'session-ready', 'clarification-answered', 'session-canceled'.
Must be in the session scope.

JSON object of operational metadata only. Keys containing token, secret, password, credential, prompt, stdout, stderr, shell, environment, cookie, authorization or repository content are replaced by '[redacted]'. Strings cut at 1000 chars, max 50 keys/items, depth 5.
Allowed here: draft, clarification-required, ready, awaiting-approval, paused, failed, canceled. approved/executing/completed are rejected. Omit to only record an event.
Send coordinatorId, leaseNonce and fencingToken all together or none.
Must be the latest nonce.
Integer >= 1, must equal the current lease token.

preconditions: Caller can manage the session's workspace

The status change is a valid transition: draft -> clarification-required|ready|canceled; clarification-required -> draft|ready|canceled; ready -> awaiting-approval|draft|canceled; awaiting-approval -> draft|canceled; approved -> paused|draft|canceled; executing -> paused|failed|canceled; paused -> failed|canceled; failed -> paused|canceled; completed and canceled are final
If fence fields are sent, the coordinator lease is active and matches them
For canceled or failed: the user explicitly asked for it
returns: session (new status, lastEventSequence, version), event {id, sequence, type, payload, createdAt}, reused (true = the same commandId was already applied).

errors.when: AISH session command id and type are required.
errors.fix: Send type and a commandId of 8+ chars.

errors.when: AISH session command project is outside session scope.
errors.fix: Use a projectId from session.scope.projectIds or omit it.

errors.when: AISH coordinated command requires coordinatorId, leaseNonce and fencingToken.
errors.fix: Send all three fence fields (fencingToken >= 1) or none of them.

errors.when: AISH coordinator lease not found. / AISH coordinator lease is not active. / AISH coordinator lease identity mismatch. / AISH coordinator fencing token is stale.
errors.fix: Call acquire_aish_coordinator_lease again (same coordinatorId, new idempotencyKey) and retry with the new leaseNonce and fencingToken.

errors.when: AISH execution state requires its dedicated authorized command.
errors.fix: Use approve_aish_execution_plan for approved, dispatch_aish_execution_plan or resume_aish_execution_session for executing; completed is set automatically.

errors.when: Invalid AISH execution session transition: <from> -> <to>.
errors.fix: Read the session status and follow the allowed transitions (e.g. draft must go to ready before awaiting-approval).

errors.when: AISH session command idempotency key conflicts with another payload. / ...with another command type.
errors.fix: Generate a new commandId for a different command.

errors.when: Execution limit cannot be replaced by an operator pause.
errors.fix: The session is already paused by a budget/timeout limit. Leave it; the owner decides.

errors.when: Use a durable checkpoint request for this pause.
errors.fix: Use request_aish_execution_checkpoint instead of payload.reason checkpoint/conflict.

errors.when: AISH workflow is not fully completed.
errors.fix: Do not force completion; wait for all plan nodes.

errors.when: You do not have permission to access this AISH execution session.
errors.fix: Caller is not a workspace manager. Stop and tell the user.

gotchas.text: Moving to awaiting-approval, paused, completed or failed sends in-app notifications to the session creator and the project owners (outward-facing).
canceled is final and cannot be undone.
Unlike pause/resume, the coordinator fence is optional here (required only when one of coordinatorId, leaseNonce or fencingToken is sent).
A ready -> awaiting-approval move does not approve anything: approval stays a manager decision via approve_aish_execution_plan.

name: apply_aish_legacy_runner_migration
purpose: Moves a legacy project-scoped runner host into a runner account (account scope limited to its original workspace and project) and records the original state so the move can be rolled back.
useWhen: preview_aish_legacy_runner_migration returned allowed = true and the user confirmed the migration
avoidWhen: You have not previewed: use preview_aish_legacy_runner_migration first
The host already has an account: use apply_aish_runner_management_action for lifecycle changes
You want to undo a migration: use rollback_aish_legacy_runner_migration

inputs.notes: Target runner account id.
Legacy host id.
Must equal the host's current updatedAt.
8 to 1000 chars; stored on the migration record.
8 to 240 chars. Write it down: migrationId is derived from it.
Must be true, only after the user confirmed.

preconditions: preview_aish_legacy_runner_migration returned allowed = true
All preview preconditions hold (account admin, account bound to the host workspace, host has no accountId)
No active capacity lease on the host
The user explicitly confirmed the migration
returns: migrationId (SAVE IT: it is the only input that rollback_aish_legacy_runner_migration accepts and no read tool returns it), host {id, accountId, status, accessPolicy, updatedAt}, reused.

errors.when: Legacy migration requires confirmation, reason, and idempotency key.
errors.fix: Send confirmed: true (after the user confirmed), a reason of 8+ chars and a key of 8+ chars.

errors.when: AISH legacy migration blocked: active-capacity-leases.
errors.fix: Wait until the runner finishes its job, then preview again.

errors.when: AISH host is already associated with a runner account.
errors.fix: If you are retrying after a lost response, the first call succeeded: confirm in get_aish_runner_management_overview (legacy = false) and do not retry.

errors.when: AISH host is not an unmigrated legacy host.
errors.fix: Host was migrated or removed meanwhile. Re-read the overview.

errors.when: AISH host changed; refresh before continuing.
errors.fix: Re-run preview_aish_legacy_runner_migration and use its new expectedUpdatedAt.

errors.when: Legacy migration idempotency key conflicts with another host.
errors.fix: Generate a new idempotency key.

errors.when: Any preview error (not bound, lineage missing, permission)
errors.fix: Apply the fix listed for preview_aish_legacy_runner_migration.

gotchas.text: Creates an active account grant 'migration-<migrationId>' and re-scopes the host's existing credentials to the account (they keep working).
If the result was lost, migrationId = SHA-256 hex of '<accountId>:<hostId>:<idempotencyKey>'.
A retry after success fails with 'already associated' (the preview runs first) instead of returning reused = true.
Only available to API keys with full/custom profile.

name: apply_aish_runner_management_action
purpose: Changes an account runner's lifecycle status (drain, suspend, reactivate or remove) after a preview, with explicit confirmation, a reason and optimistic concurrency.
useWhen: The user asked to stop a runner from taking new work (drain)
The user asked to take a runner out of service (suspend)
The user asked to bring a drained or suspended runner back (reactivate)
The user asked to decommission a runner (remove)
avoidWhen: You have not run preview_aish_runner_management_action with allowed = true: run it first
The host is legacy: use preview_aish_legacy_runner_migration / apply_aish_legacy_runner_migration
You need to rotate a host credential: use CLI `lpm aish fleet rotate-credential` (owner decision)
You want to rename a runner: use CLI `lpm aish hosts rename`

inputs.notes: Runner account id.
Account host id.
Enum: drain | suspend | reactivate | remove. Must be the action you previewed.
Must equal the host's current updatedAt exactly.
Why the change is made; 8 to 1000 chars. Stored in the audit trail.
8 to 240 chars, e.g. 'runner-drain-<hostId>-<date>'. Reuse the same key only to retry the same request.
Must be true. Set it only after the user explicitly confirmed this action on this runner.

preconditions: preview_aish_runner_management_action returned allowed = true
Caller is the account owner or an account admin; the account is active
The user explicitly confirmed the action (and, for remove, the runner account owner agreed)
For suspend or remove: the host has no active capacity lease
returns: host {id, status (new lifecycle status), updatedAt, displayName, accessPolicy, ...}, action, reused (true = an earlier call with the same key and payload already applied it).

errors.when: AISH runner management action requires explicit confirmation.
errors.fix: Ask the user to confirm, then send confirmed: true.

errors.when: AISH runner management reason must contain at least 8 characters.
errors.fix: Write a real reason of 8+ characters.

errors.when: AISH runner management idempotency key must contain at least 8 characters.
errors.fix: Generate a key of 8+ characters.

errors.when: AISH runner action blocked: active-capacity-leases.
errors.fix: Drain first (drain is never blocked), wait until preview shows activeLeaseCount = 0, then preview and apply suspend/remove again.

errors.when: AISH host changed; refresh before continuing.
errors.fix: If you are retrying after a timeout, first read get_aish_runner_management_overview: if administrativeStatus already equals the target status, the earlier call succeeded, stop. Otherwise re-run the preview and use its new expectedUpdatedAt.

errors.when: AISH runner management idempotency key conflicts with another payload.
errors.fix: That key was used for a different action/reason. Generate a new key.

errors.when: AISH host not found in this account. / permission or account errors
errors.fix: Same fixes as preview_aish_runner_management_action.

gotchas.text: remove is a logical removal: host status becomes revoked, all its agents and slots are suspended, and ALL its credentials and grants are revoked (history is kept).
reactivate sets status online and clears the removal fields but does NOT restore revoked credentials or grants: a removed runner needs a new credential and grant before it can work again.
The apply re-runs the preview first, so a retry after a success usually fails with 'AISH host changed' instead of returning reused = true.
drain/suspend are enforced by the fenced host worker protocol; local runners that call lease_aish_runner_job with this hostId are not stopped by the host status.
Only available to API keys with full/custom profile.

name: create_aish_execution_session
purpose: Creates (or idempotently reuses) a draft AISH execution session, the cockpit record that holds an objective, its project scope, the plan and an ordered event log for governed AI execution.
useWhen: The user asked to run work through AISH runners (the Execution Cockpit) for one project or for several projects of one workspace
No existing session already covers this objective (check list_aish_execution_sessions first)
avoidWhen: A session for this objective already exists: use list_aish_execution_sessions and get_aish_execution_session
You need one standalone job, not a planned multi-step session: use create_aish_job
The work is done outside AISH (Claude Code, Codex, an editor): track it with the 'LPM-Activity: <issueId>' commit trailer instead

inputs.notes: All projects must belong to this workspace.
Enum: project | workspace. Any other value is treated as project.
Array of ids. scopeType project: exactly 1. scopeType workspace: 1 or more. Duplicates removed, max 100. Order matters for idempotent reuse.
What the session must deliver; max 4000 chars. Do not put secrets in it.
8 to 240 chars. Reuse the same key (with identical objective/scope/projectIds) only to retry.

preconditions: Caller can manage the workspace (workspace manager)
Every projectId exists and belongs to workspaceId
The user explicitly asked for AISH execution
returns: session {id (= sessionId for every other cockpit tool), status 'draft', scope {type, workspaceId, projectIds}, objective, version, lastEventSequence (1), currentPlanHash (null), approvedPlanHash (null), createdAt}, reused.

errors.when: Workspace, objective, project scope, and idempotency key are required.
errors.fix: Send workspaceId, a non-empty objective, at least one projectId and a key of 8+ chars.

errors.when: Project session requires exactly one project.
errors.fix: Send one projectId, or use scopeType 'workspace' for several projects.

errors.when: You do not have permission to create this AISH execution session.
errors.fix: Caller is not a workspace manager. Stop and tell the user.

errors.when: Project <id> is outside the session workspace.
errors.fix: Remove that project or use its own workspaceId.

errors.when: AISH execution session idempotency key conflicts with another request.
errors.fix: The key was used with a different objective/scope/project list. Generate a new key.

gotchas.text: sessionId is derived from workspaceId + calling user + idempotencyKey, so the same key from another user creates a different session.
Sessions cannot be deleted; end one with append_aish_execution_session_command nextStatus 'canceled'.
Creating a session spends nothing; execution still needs a plan, manager approval of the plan hash, owner funding and runners.
Workflow jobs stop being leasable plan.authorization.timeoutMinutes after the session's createdAt, so create the session close to when work will run.
Only available to API keys with full/custom profile.

name: get_aish_execution_session
purpose: Reads one AISH execution session: status, current plan, workflow progress, releases, open checkpoint, coordinator lease (without its nonce) and the events after a given sequence number.
useWhen: You need the current status, currentPlanHash, pauseReason or activeCheckpointId before another cockpit call
You are polling for new events (pass afterSequence = previous cursor)
You need to see who holds the coordinator lease and when it expires
avoidWhen: You do not know the sessionId: use list_aish_execution_sessions
You need readiness facts before approval: use get_aish_execution_readiness
You need one job's details: use get_aish_job

inputs.notes: Session id.
Integer; default 0 returns all visible events.

preconditions: Caller can read the session's workspace
returns: session {id, status, objective, scope, currentPlanVersion, currentPlanHash, approvedPlanHash, pauseReason, activeCheckpointId, lastEventSequence}, workflow (node progress), canManage, releases[] (with canApprove), checkpoint, events[] {id, sequence, type, actorId, projectId, payload, createdAt}, cursor (next afterSequence), coordinatorLease {coordinatorId, fencingToken, status, leasedAt, expiresAt} (no leaseNonce), plan, nodeRuns[].

errors.when: AISH execution session not found.
errors.fix: Wrong sessionId. Use list_aish_execution_sessions.

errors.when: You do not have permission to access this AISH execution session.
errors.fix: Caller cannot read the workspace. Stop and tell the user.

gotchas.text: leaseNonce is never returned here; keep the one from acquire_aish_coordinator_lease.
Compare coordinatorLease.fencingToken with yours to know whether you are still the coordinator.
Events, plan nodes and runs of projects you cannot read are hidden, and checkpoint is null if any project is hidden.

name: get_aish_runner_management_overview
purpose: Lists the runners (hosts) of one AISH runner account with health, busy/idle state, usage time, permissions, capacity and last task, paginated and without secrets.
useWhen: You need to know which runners of an account are online, stale, offline, busy or idle
You need a runner's hostId and its current updatedAt before preview_aish_runner_management_action or preview_aish_legacy_runner_migration
You need to find legacy project-scoped hosts to migrate (runners[].legacy = true)
The user asks how many hours runners worked in total or what a runner ran last
avoidWhen: You need execution time for a period grouped by workspace, project, runner or job: use get_aish_usage_report
You need the state of one job: use get_aish_job
You need the sessions/plans being executed: use list_aish_execution_sessions

inputs.source: user (no MCP tool lists runner accounts; the user can run CLI `lpm aish accounts list` or copy it from the AISH page in the web app)
inputs.notes: Runner account id, max 160 chars.
Default false: hides runners with administrativeStatus revoked or a removedAt date. Set true to audit removed runners.
Default true (only an explicit false hides them): includes legacy project-scoped hosts found in workspaces bound to the account.
Case-insensitive substring over displayName, hostname, id and capabilities. Max 160 chars.
One value matched against administrativeStatus (pending|online|draining|offline|suspended|revoked), health (online|stale|offline|unknown) or workState (busy|idle). 'all' or empty = no filter.
Omit on the first page.
Page size, default 50, min 1, max 100.

preconditions: The runner account exists
Caller is the account owner or an account admin (full view, canManage=true), OR can read at least one workspace actively bound to the account (read-only view, canManage=false, remoteAccess hidden)
Connection uses an LPM API key; this tool is not offered to OAuth connectors (ChatGPT/Claude)
returns: account, canManage (true = you may call preview/apply tools), generatedAt, totals {runners, online, busy, attention, accumulatedHours, legacy, unattributedJobCount}, runners[] {id (= hostId for other tools), legacy, displayName, hostname, administrativeStatus, health, workState, workerReadiness, lastHeartbeatAt, lastTask {id, title, status, projectId, completedAt}, usage, capacity {agents, slots, activeSlots, activeLeases}, capabilities, permissions, grants[], recentAudit[], updatedAt (use as expectedUpdatedAt), removedAt}, pagination {limit, hasMore, nextCursor}.

errors.when: AISH runner account not found.
errors.fix: The accountId is wrong. Ask the user for the correct runner account id.

errors.when: You do not have permission to read this AISH runner account.
errors.fix: Caller is neither account owner/admin nor a reader of a bound workspace. Stop and tell the user; the account owner must grant access.

errors.when: Invalid AISH runner management cursor.
errors.fix: Call again without cursor to restart from the first page.

gotchas.text: totals count every runner that passes the filters, not only the current page; loop with pagination.nextCursor while hasMore is true.
Health: online = heartbeat < 90 s, stale = 90 s to 5 min, offline = > 5 min or suspended/revoked, unknown = never sent a heartbeat.
Legacy hosts are searched only in the first 50 active bound workspaces.
The query is heavy (reads all leases and jobs of the account): do not poll it in a tight loop.

name: lease_aish_runner_job
purpose: Claims the oldest executable queued AISH job of a project for a local runner for 10 minutes and opens its one financial consumption attempt; returns the job or null.
useWhen: You are a local runner process that will immediately execute the returned job and then call submit_aish_job_evidence before the lease expires
avoidWhen: You only want to see queued jobs: use list_aish_jobs or get_aish_job (leasing locks the job and its funding)
The machine is a registered remote host: use CLI `lpm aish host start` (fenced host protocol)
The job is a release/deploy job (recipe deploy-gated): use claim_aish_release
You cannot execute the job right now

inputs.notes: Only jobs of this project are considered.
Max 160 chars.
Exactly 'aish-budget/1'. Declare it only if your executor enforces the job's cost cap.
Exactly 'aish-consumption/1'.
Runner presence session (not a cockpit session).
Same rules as upsert_aish_runner_session.
'aish-execution/1'. Without it, jobs that have a repository path are skipped.
'aish-agent-context/1'. Without it, jobs with an agentBinding are skipped.
'aish-engineering-policy/1'. Without it, builder jobs are skipped.

preconditions: Caller can manage the project
A job is queued (or leased with an expired lease) and its execution gate is open (approve_aish_job_execution, or dispatch_aish_execution_plan for cockpit jobs)
The job has a funded financial reservation (fund_aish_job, an owner-only decision) whose project budget is not paused and that has no earlier attempt
For cockpit workflow jobs: the session status is executing, the plan is approved and its timeoutMinutes window (counted from session creation) has not passed
The user started or approved running this runner
returns: null when nothing is leasable; otherwise the job {id (= jobId), title, prompt, projectId, issueId, status 'leased', executionRecipeId, repository, agentBinding, lease {leaseId (= attemptId for submit_aish_job_evidence and record_aish_consumption), runnerId, sessionId, hostId, leasedAt, expiresAt}}.

errors.when: Runner must declare aish-budget/1 cost-cap enforcement before leasing.
errors.fix: Send budgetVersion 'aish-budget/1' (only if your executor really enforces the cap).

errors.when: Upgrade the local runner: aish-consumption/1 attempt support is required before leasing.
errors.fix: Send consumptionLedgerVersion 'aish-consumption/1'.

errors.when: Runner id is required.
errors.fix: Send runnerId.

errors.when: Registered AISH host ... errors / project or account permission errors
errors.fix: Same fixes as upsert_aish_runner_session.

errors.when: Unreconciled financial attempt prevents another execution; use a new job after reconciliation.
errors.fix: Do not retry this job. Tell the user; the job needs reconciliation and a new job.

errors.when: Result is null
errors.fix: Nothing is leasable. Check list_aish_jobs/get_aish_job (status queued? execution gate open?), get_aish_budget (funded? paused?), and that you sent all version constants. Wait at least 10 s before polling again.

gotchas.text: Each funded job allows exactly ONE attempt: once leased, if you never submit evidence the job cannot be leased again after the 10-minute lease expires (it needs reconciliation and a new job).
There is no lease renewal in this tool; submit evidence within 10 min. Jobs that need a version constant you did not send are skipped silently (null).
Leasing does not check the host's draining/suspended status.
Prefer the CLI, which leases, runs the executor and submits evidence in one loop.

verifiedFrom: leaseAishRunnerJobCommand, upsertAishRunnerSessionCommand, canLeaseAishManifestJob, isAishLeaseAvailable, readAishFundedJob, prepareAishFinancialClaim, assertAishWorkflowJobLease

name: list_aish_execution_sessions
purpose: Lists the AISH execution sessions of a workspace that the caller may see, newest activity first, with status, recommended next action, node counts and a web deep link.
useWhen: Before creating a session, to check whether one already exists for the objective
The user asks what AISH work is in progress, waiting for approval, paused or failed
You need a sessionId
avoidWhen: You already have the sessionId and need events, plan or coordinator lease: use get_aish_execution_session
You need standalone jobs of a project: use list_aish_jobs

inputs.notes: Workspace to list.
Keeps sessions whose scope includes ANY of these projects.
Array of: draft, clarification-required, ready, awaiting-approval, approved, executing, paused, completed, failed, canceled. Unknown values are silently ignored.
Omit on the first page.
Default 20, min 1, max 50.

preconditions: Caller can read the workspace
Sessions that include any project the caller cannot read are hidden
returns: items[] {session {id, status, objective, scope, currentPlanVersion, currentPlanHash, approvedPlanHash, pauseReason, activeCheckpointId, updatedAt}, lastEventAt, lastEventType, recommendedAction (continue-plan | answer-clarification | request-approval | review-and-approve | select-runner-and-start | view-progress | resume-or-cancel | review-and-retry | view-evidence | view-history), nodeCounts {total, pending, running, completed, failed}, metrics {recordedDurationMs, evidenceCount}, targeting {mode, hostIds}, deepLink}, canCreate, nextCursor, totalEstimate.

errors.when: You do not have permission to list AISH execution sessions in this workspace.
errors.fix: Wrong workspaceId or caller cannot read it. Check list_workspaces.

errors.when: Invalid AISH continuity cursor.
errors.fix: Call again without cursor.

gotchas.text: deepLink is a web path ('/aish?tab=cockpit&session=<id>'); prefix it with https://lpm.rocks when giving it to a person.
canCreate tells whether create_aish_execution_session will be allowed.
There is no dedicated `lpm aish cockpit list` subcommand.

name: pause_aish_execution_session
purpose: Pauses an AISH execution session under coordinator fencing so no new workflow jobs start; reason checkpoint or conflict opens a durable checkpoint instead.
useWhen: The user asks to pause running AISH work
Something looks wrong during execution and the user agrees to stop new jobs
avoidWhen: Stopping for good: use append_aish_execution_session_command with nextStatus 'canceled'
A human must decide on a conflict or checkpoint with evidence: use request_aish_execution_checkpoint
Continuing after a pause: use resume_aish_execution_session

inputs.notes: Session id.
Must match the active lease.
Latest nonce.
Integer >= 1, current token.
8 to 240 chars, unique per pause. Reuse only to retry the same pause.
Enum: operator | checkpoint | conflict | budget | timeout. Omit it (defaults to operator). checkpoint/conflict redirect to request_aish_execution_checkpoint. NEVER send budget or timeout yourself.

preconditions: Caller can manage the session's workspace
You hold the current coordinator lease (acquire_aish_coordinator_lease)
Session status is approved, executing, failed or already paused
The user asked for or agreed to the pause
returns: session {status 'paused', pauseReason, lastEventSequence}, event {id, sequence, type 'session-paused'}, reused. With reason checkpoint/conflict: the request_aish_execution_checkpoint result instead.

errors.when: Invalid AISH pause reason.
errors.fix: Omit reason or use one of the enum values.

errors.when: AISH pause command requires coordinatorId, leaseNonce and fencingToken.
errors.fix: Call acquire_aish_coordinator_lease and send all three values.

errors.when: AISH coordinator lease not found / is not active / identity mismatch / fencing token is stale.
errors.fix: Re-acquire the lease (same coordinatorId, new idempotencyKey) and retry with the new nonce and token.

errors.when: Invalid AISH execution session transition: <status> -> paused.
errors.fix: Only approved, executing or failed sessions can be paused. A draft/ready session needs no pause.

errors.when: Execution limit cannot be replaced by an operator pause.
errors.fix: It is already paused by a budget/timeout limit. Nothing to do; tell the user.

errors.when: AISH session command id and type are required.
errors.fix: Use a commandId of 8+ chars.

gotchas.text: A pause with reason budget or timeout can never be resumed (a new reviewed session is required), so never send those values.
Pausing does not kill a job already running on a runner; it only stops new workflow jobs from being leased.
The pause sends in-app notifications to the session creator and project owners.

name: preview_aish_legacy_runner_migration
purpose: Dry-runs moving a legacy project-scoped runner host into a runner account, showing the source scope, the resulting account scope and any blockers, without changing anything.
useWhen: get_aish_runner_management_overview shows a runner with legacy = true that the user wants managed by the account
Always before apply_aish_legacy_runner_migration
avoidWhen: The host already belongs to an account (legacy = false): use preview_aish_runner_management_action for lifecycle changes
You only want to list hosts: use get_aish_runner_management_overview

inputs.notes: Target runner account id.
Legacy host id (host without accountId).
ISO timestamp; if given it must match the host's current updatedAt.

preconditions: Caller is the owner or an admin of the target account, and the account is active
Host exists, has no accountId, and has both workspaceId and projectId
The account is bound (binding not revoked) to the host's workspace (CLI `lpm aish accounts bind-workspace --account <id> --workspace <id>`)
Caller can read the host's project
returns: allowed, blockingReasons (['active-capacity-leases'] when busy), expectedUpdatedAt (pass to apply), source {workspaceId, projectId, scope}, target {accountId, scope: 'account', allowedWorkspaceIds, allowedProjectIds}, impact {activeLeaseCount, credentialCount, historyPreserved, rollbackSupported}.

errors.when: AISH legacy host not found.
errors.fix: Wrong hostId. Re-read get_aish_runner_management_overview.

errors.when: AISH host is already associated with a runner account.
errors.fix: The host is already migrated. Use preview_aish_runner_management_action for lifecycle changes.

errors.when: AISH host changed; refresh before continuing.
errors.fix: Re-read runners[].updatedAt and call again.

errors.when: AISH legacy host is missing deterministic project/workspace lineage.
errors.fix: This host cannot be migrated automatically. Stop and report it to the user.

errors.when: AISH runner account is not bound to the legacy host workspace.
errors.fix: The account owner must bind the workspace first (CLI `lpm aish accounts bind-workspace`). Ask the user; do not do it on your own.

errors.when: Project <id> not found / You do not have access to this project
errors.fix: Caller cannot read the host's project. Stop and tell the user.

errors.when: AISH runner account not found / is not active / You do not have permission to manage this AISH runner account.
errors.fix: Check accountId; only the account owner or admins can migrate.

gotchas.text: The migration keeps the same reach: the new account policy allows only the host's original workspace and project and sets requiresTargeting = true.
Active leases block it; wait until the runner is idle.

name: preview_aish_runner_management_action
purpose: Dry-runs a lifecycle action (drain, suspend, reactivate, remove) on an account runner and reports whether it is allowed and what it would affect, without changing anything.
useWhen: Always before apply_aish_runner_management_action
You need to know whether active leases block suspend or remove
You need the runner's current expectedUpdatedAt
avoidWhen: The host is legacy (runners[].legacy = true, no account): use preview_aish_legacy_runner_migration first
You only want to see runner status: use get_aish_runner_management_overview
You want to rename a runner: use CLI `lpm aish hosts rename --account <id> --host <id> --display-name <name> --dry-run`

inputs.notes: Runner account id.

inputs.source: get_aish_runner_management_overview -> runners[].id (only runners with legacy = false)
inputs.notes: Host must belong to this account.
Enum: drain (stop new work, current job may finish) | suspend (block all work) | reactivate (back to online) | remove (logical removal, revokes credentials and grants).
ISO timestamp. If given and the host changed since, the call fails.

preconditions: Runner account exists and its status is active
Caller is the account owner or an account admin (overview canManage = true)
Host belongs to the account (not a legacy host)
returns: allowed (boolean), blockingReasons (e.g. ['active-capacity-leases']), currentStatus, targetStatus (drain -> draining, suspend -> suspended, reactivate -> online, remove -> revoked), expectedUpdatedAt (pass it to apply), impact {activeLeaseCount, agentCount, slotCount, activeCredentialCount, activeGrantCount, logicalRemoval, historyPreserved}.

errors.when: Unsupported AISH runner management action.
errors.fix: Use exactly one of: drain, suspend, reactivate, remove.

errors.when: AISH runner account not found. / AISH runner account is not active.
errors.fix: Check the accountId with the user; an inactive account cannot be managed.

errors.when: You do not have permission to manage this AISH runner account.
errors.fix: Only the account owner or admins can manage runners. Stop and tell the user.

errors.when: AISH host not found in this account.
errors.fix: Wrong hostId, or the host is legacy. Re-read get_aish_runner_management_overview; for legacy hosts migrate first.

errors.when: AISH host changed; refresh before continuing.
errors.fix: Re-read get_aish_runner_management_overview and use the new runners[].updatedAt.

gotchas.text: Only suspend and remove are blocked by active leases; drain is never blocked.
To take a busy runner down: drain, wait until impact.activeLeaseCount = 0 (a lease lasts at most 10 min unless renewed by the host), then suspend or remove.
The preview does not check the current status (e.g. reactivating an already online runner shows allowed = true).

name: resume_aish_execution_session
purpose: Moves a paused (or approved or failed) AISH execution session back to executing under coordinator fencing.
useWhen: The user asks to continue a session paused by an operator
A manager resolved the session's checkpoint with action resume
avoidWhen: pauseReason is budget or timeout: resume is refused; the owner must review a new session (budgets are owner decisions)
An open checkpoint is not resolved: a manager must use resolve_aish_execution_checkpoint (agents cannot decide)
You need new jobs to start: after resuming call dispatch_aish_execution_plan
Failed nodes must run again: use retry_aish_execution_plan

inputs.notes: Session id.
Must match the active lease.
Latest nonce.
Integer >= 1, current token.
8 to 240 chars, unique per resume. Reuse only to retry the same resume.

preconditions: Caller can manage the session's workspace and holds the current coordinator lease
Session status is paused, approved or failed
approvedPlanHash equals currentPlanHash (the current plan is approved)
Any activeCheckpointId is resolved with action resume
pauseReason is not budget or timeout
The user asked for or agreed to the resume
returns: session {status 'executing', pauseReason null, activeCheckpointId null, lastEventSequence}, event {id, sequence, type 'session-resumed'}, reused.

errors.when: AISH resume command requires coordinatorId, leaseNonce and fencingToken.
errors.fix: Call acquire_aish_coordinator_lease and send all three values.

errors.when: AISH coordinator lease not found / is not active / identity mismatch / fencing token is stale.
errors.fix: Re-acquire the lease (same coordinatorId, new idempotencyKey) and retry with the new nonce and token.

errors.when: AISH execution requires a current approved plan.
errors.fix: The plan changed after approval. A manager must approve the current plan hash (approve_aish_execution_plan) first.

errors.when: A recorded checkpoint decision is required before resuming.
errors.fix: Ask a manager to resolve the checkpoint with resolve_aish_execution_checkpoint (action resume).

errors.when: The execution limit requires a newly reviewed session; resuming cannot extend its authorization.
errors.fix: Stop. Tell the user the budget/timeout limit was reached; the owner decides on a new session.

errors.when: Invalid AISH execution session transition: <status> -> executing.
errors.fix: Only paused, approved or failed sessions can be resumed.

gotchas.text: Resume only changes the status; it does not create jobs.
Call dispatch_aish_execution_plan with session.currentPlanHash to start dependency-ready nodes.
Workflow jobs stop being leasable once plan.authorization.timeoutMinutes have passed since the session was created, even while executing.

name: rollback_aish_legacy_runner_migration
purpose: Undoes an applied legacy runner migration: restores the host's original project scope and credentials scope and revokes the grant the migration created.
useWhen: The user asks to undo a legacy runner migration (for example the runner stopped receiving work after migrating)
avoidWhen: You want to stop or remove the runner instead: use preview_aish_runner_management_action / apply_aish_runner_management_action
The migration was never applied or is already rolled back (overview shows legacy = true): nothing to do

inputs.notes: Runner account id.
64-char hex. If lost: SHA-256 hex of '<accountId>:<hostId>:<idempotencyKey>' used on apply.

inputs.source: get_aish_runner_management_overview -> runners[].updatedAt of that host (read it right before the call)
inputs.notes: Must equal the host's current updatedAt.
8 to 1000 chars.
Must be true, only after the user confirmed.

preconditions: Caller is the owner or an admin of the account, and the account is active
The migration record exists for this account with status applied
The host still belongs to the account and still carries this migrationId
No active capacity lease on the host
The user explicitly confirmed the rollback
returns: migrationId, status 'rolled-back', host {id, accountId (null again), workspaceId, projectId, accessPolicy, updatedAt}.

errors.when: Legacy migration rollback requires confirmation and reason.
errors.fix: Send confirmed: true (after the user confirmed) and a reason of 8+ chars.

errors.when: Applied AISH legacy migration not found.
errors.fix: Wrong migrationId/accountId, or it was already rolled back. Check the overview: legacy = true means the rollback is already done. Do not retry.

errors.when: Applied AISH legacy migration changed; rollback refused.
errors.fix: Someone changed the migration meanwhile. Re-read the overview and ask the user.

errors.when: AISH migrated host lineage changed; rollback refused.
errors.fix: The host was moved or migrated again. Automatic rollback is impossible; stop and report to the user.

errors.when: AISH migrated host changed; refresh before rollback.
errors.fix: Re-read runners[].updatedAt. If the host was changed on purpose after the migration (rename, lifecycle action), confirm with the user before retrying with the new value.

errors.when: AISH legacy migration rollback blocked: active-capacity-leases.
errors.fix: Wait until the runner is idle (or drain it first), then retry.

gotchas.text: No idempotency key: a second call after success fails with 'Applied AISH legacy migration not found.'.
The migration record and audit history are kept (status rolled-back); the host becomes a legacy project host again.
Only available to API keys with full/custom profile.

name: upsert_aish_runner_session
purpose: Records a local AISH runner's presence for a project (start, heartbeat or end) so it appears online and its runtime is attributed.
useWhen: You are acting as a local AISH runner process: send event 'start' when you begin, 'heartbeat' about every 30 s, 'end' when you stop
avoidWhen: You want to take work: lease_aish_runner_job already sends a heartbeat
The machine is a registered remote host: run CLI `lpm aish host start` (fenced host-credential protocol), not this tool
You want to see runner health: use get_aish_runner_management_overview

inputs.notes: Project the runner works for.
Max 160 chars, unique per runner, e.g. '<hostname>:<pid>'. Same value later in lease_aish_runner_job.

inputs.source: agent-generated UUID, one per runner run
inputs.notes: Defaults to runnerId. Must keep the same runnerId, projectId and hostId for its whole life.
Only for a host registered in a runner account; legacy hosts are rejected.
Enum: start | heartbeat | end. Any other value counts as start.
Array of strings, max 20, e.g. ['local-command'].

preconditions: Caller can manage the project

If hostId is sent: the host belongs to a runner account, the caller is that account's owner/admin, the account is active, and the host's scope allows this project (project-scoped host = same project; account host = account bound to the project's workspace)

errors.when: Runner id is required.
errors.fix: Send a non-empty runnerId.

errors.when: Registered AISH host not found for local runner session.
errors.fix: hostId is wrong or a legacy host. Omit hostId, or migrate the host first.

errors.when: Registered AISH host cannot execute this project.
errors.fix: The host is scoped to another project. Use the right project or omit hostId.

errors.when: Registered AISH host account is not bound to this workspace.
errors.fix: The account owner must bind the workspace; ask the user.

errors.when: AISH runner session id conflicts with another identity binding.
errors.fix: Generate a new sessionId (UUID) for this runner run.

errors.when: You do not have permission to manage this project / ...this AISH runner account.
errors.fix: Caller lacks manage rights. Stop and tell the user.

cli: lpm aish runner start --project <projectId> --executor-command <command> --budget-contract aish-budget/1 [--runner-id <id>] [--host <hostId>] (sends start/heartbeat/end automatically); single call: lpm aish command upsert_aish_runner_session --file <payload.json> --transport mcp --json

gotchas.text: The runner record is keyed by runnerId alone: reusing a runnerId in another project overwrites its project binding, so keep runnerIds unique.
Always send event 'end' when stopping, otherwise the runner shows as stale then offline.
This tool does not check the host's lifecycle status (draining/suspended).
